page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density position this instance as a premium resource tier designed for workloads requiring sustained CPU performance without hyper-threading interference, alongside a large memory footprint.

Given the combination of 80 dedicated physical cores, 768.0 GB of RAM, and 25 Gbps network bandwidth, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, enterprise applications, and high-performance computing workloads that benefit from high memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution.
